gates.description: At least one mobile source file must be produced
Offline handling must be addressed in implementation or docs
Network failure and error states must be handled
No hardcoded API keys or secrets in mobile source
Loading states shown during async operations

anti_patterns.description: Building a web app and wrapping it in WebView — users notice, platform features unavailable
App crashes when returning from background — lifecycle events not handled
App shows blank screen when offline — no local caching or offline fallback
Sending push notifications for every event — users disable or uninstall
Submitting features violating app store policies — rejection delays release

escalation_triggers: Platform OS update introduces a breaking change in the next release
App store rejection for a policy reason affecting core functionality
Performance degradation that cannot be fixed without architectural changes
Third-party SDK has a critical bug and vendor is unresponsive
Push notification delivery rate drops below acceptable threshold

output_certifications: Mobile feature implemented per platform guidelines
